description: Lost or stalled, escalated by design: the payer of KIK-1025 says the $64.00 wall plate shows delivered but isn't in their post box. Expected step-up SHIPMENT_DELIVERED: the carrier shows it delivered. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: Wall plate KIK-1025 not here
messages.body:
Hi,

My wall plate, order KIK-1025, shows as delivered, but it isn't in my post box and the post office doesn't have it. Please could I have the $64.00 back?

Regards.
